name: std::sub_match<BidirIt>::operator string_type, std::sub_match<BidirIt>::str
intro:
Converts to an object of the underlying std::basic_string type.

1) An implicit conversion.

2) An explicit conversion.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The matched character sequence as an object of the underlying std::basic_string type. If the matched member is false, then returns the empty string.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the length of the underlying character sequence.

summary: Converts to an object of the underlying std::basic_string type.
